mapper.select: SELECT FROM fee_item WHERE fee_item_id = #{feeItemId} AND FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM fee_charge charge JOIN fee_item item ON item.fee_item_id = charge.fee_item_id WHERE charge.fee_item_id = #{feeItemId} AND item.deleted_dttm IS NULL ORDER BY charge.fee_charge_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT item.fee_item_id, item.name, item.description, item.reference_year, item.reference_term_code, item.amount, item.due_date, item.status_code, COUNT(charge.fee_charge_id) AS target_count, COALESCE(SUM(charge.status_code = 'PAID'), 0) AS paid_count, COALESCE(SUM(charge.status_code = 'UNPAID'), 0) AS unpaid_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN charge.status_code = 'PAID' THEN charge.charged_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paid_amount FROM fee_item item LEFT JOIN fee_charge charge ON charge.fee_item_id = item.fee_item_id WHERE item.deleted_dttm IS NULL GROUP BY item.fee_item_id, item.name, item.description, item.reference_year, item.reference_term_code, item.amount, item.due_date, item.status_code ORDER BY item.reference_year DESC, item.reference_term_code DESC, item.due_date DESC, item.fee_item_id DESC

SELECT charge.fee_charge_id, charge.member_id, target.name AS member_name, charge.charged_amount, charge.status_code, charge.paid_dttm, processor.name AS processed_by_name, charge.process_note FROM fee_charge charge JOIN fee_item item ON item.fee_item_id = charge.fee_item_id JOIN member target ON target.member_id = charge.member_id LEFT JOIN member processor ON processor.member_id = charge.processed_by_member_id WHERE charge.fee_item_id = #{feeItemId} AND item.deleted_dttm IS NULL ORDER BY target.name, target.member_id

SELECT history.fee_charge_history_id, history.fee_charge_id, history.previous_status_code, history.new_status_code, history.amount, history.reason, history.changed_by_member_id, member.name AS changed_by_name, history.changed_dttm FROM fee_charge_history history JOIN fee_charge charge ON charge.fee_charge_id = history.fee_charge_id JOIN fee_item item ON item.fee_item_id = charge.fee_item_id JOIN member ON member.member_id = history.changed_by_member_id WHERE history.fee_charge_id = #{feeChargeId} AND item.deleted_dttm IS NULL ORDER BY history.changed_dttm DESC, history.fee_charge_history_id DESC

SELECT charge.fee_charge_id, item.fee_item_id, item.name AS item_name, item.reference_year, item.reference_term_code, charge.charged_amount, charge.status_code AS status, item.due_date, charge.paid_dttm FROM fee_charge charge JOIN fee_item item ON item.fee_item_id = charge.fee_item_id WHERE charge.member_id = #{memberId} AND charge.status_code <> 'CANCELLED' AND item.status_code <> 'CANCELLED' AND item.deleted_dttm IS NULL ORDER BY item.due_date DESC, item.fee_item_id DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN charge.status_code IN ('UNPAID', 'PAID') THEN charge.charged_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN charge.status_code = 'PAID' THEN charge.charged_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paid_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN charge.status_code = 'UNPAID' THEN charge.charged_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unpaid_amount FROM fee_charge charge JOIN fee_item item ON item.fee_item_id = charge.fee_item_id WHERE charge.member_id = #{memberId} AND charge.status_code <> 'CANCELLED' AND item.status_code <> 'CANCELLED' AND item.deleted_dttm IS NULL
